_comment: Value-golden ratchet. `covered` tools have an assertion in selfcheck.mjs that pins a computed value (a 格局 name, a percentage, a 起运岁) — not a section header — in a block that CALLS something imported from src/tools/<tool>.js (a name in a check title or a comment does not count). `covered_via` lists helper modules with no runner of their own, covered through the tool that calls them. `debt` is the uncovered remainder and may only shrink; a NEW tool must arrive with a golden. Expected values need an authority comment (upstream jest golden / desktop same-chart / astronomical fact), per docs/LESSONS.md. Refresh with `uv run python scripts/verify_value_goldens.py --update-baseline`.

placeResolve.what: runPlaceSearch(...).data.verdict is placeResolve's acceptance verdict; the placeSearch golden pins verdict.status / verdict.match (NYC → 纽约 -04:00, St. Petersburg ambiguous, batch HK resolved)
